item.title: Undertone 1.33.0
item.description:
• New here? Undertone now starts with a sample meeting under Meetings: a made-up standup with its recap, action items, explained terms and transcript, so you can see what you get after a call. Delete it whenever you like.
  • A Get started checklist on Tasks and Home: open the sample, connect your calendar, record your first meeting, ask a question, run a recipe, import your org chart, set up a team and connect a work tool. Each step ticks itself off when you do it, and you can hide the list.

Undertone 1.32.1

  • Customer calls is now Accounts: a card for every company you meet with, showing whether things are active, cooling off or quiet, a 12-week strip of your meetings, the people and how often you talk. Filter by status, sort, and ask across all accounts from one button.
  • Each account has a profile (first and last meeting, rhythm, people, copy all emails), one-click Health check and Call prep, a question box and a month-by-month timeline of your meetings.
  • Recipes: click the eye on any recipe to read its full prompt before you run it, copy it, or save your own version.

Undertone 1.32.0

  • Recipes: one-click prompts that run in Ask, like Recap my week, List recent todos, Pipeline prep, Gather product feedback or Coach me. Save your own and share them with your team. Three show under Ask.
  • Customer calls: your meetings with people from other companies, grouped by company, with a question box and recipes for all of them or one company. Worked out on your Mac from who was invited.
  • Team analytics for admins (Team page › Analytics): meetings per week, shared recaps, action items and who's active. Meeting counts are numbers only and each person can turn them off in Settings › Team.

Undertone 1.31.0

  • Undertone Business: Pro for everyone on your team. Admins start it from Settings › Team, pick how many seats, and check out through Paddle. Everyone with a seat gets Pro on their own.
  • Settings › Team shows seats used, when the plan renews and who doesn't have a seat yet. Admins can add or remove seats there.
  • A Business badge on the Team page.

Undertone 1.30.0

  • Onboarding guides now write in the background. Close the window and keep working; a spinner in Guides shows it's writing, and you get a notification when the draft is ready to review.
  • Share a guide by link: anyone with the link can read it in a browser. Links last 7 days, 30 days or until you turn them off.
  • Up next shows your Mac calendar right away and checks Google Calendar quietly in the background.
